subgoal_validations.details: The agent converts the Word file at docs/customer_report.docx to a PDF before sending any email.
explanations: Check: "The agent converts the Word file at docs/customer_report.docx to a PDF before sending any email." has passed successfully.

The subgoal requires an actual file conversion before any email is sent, so relevant tool use is mandatory. Here, the agent used `run_command` to invoke the conversion tool `skills/OfficeBench/tools/word/convert_to_pdf.py`. The first conversion attempt failed, but after installing `fpdf2`, the second conversion succeeded with output: `OBSERVATION: Successfully convert ./testbed/docs/customer_report.docx to ./testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf`. The agent then verified the PDF existed via `ls -la /workspace/testbed/docs/customer_report.pdf`. Only after that did it run the email-sending command. Although there was an earlier attempted email command proposal, no successful email was sent before conversion; the actual successful send happened after conversion and verification.

GRADE: C

Therefore, the required subgoal was achieved.
